newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar raises customs duty on tobacco products.
newsitem.headline: Qatar raises customs duty on tobacco products.

text.p: Qatar on Sunday raised customs duty on tobacco and related products to 70 percent from 50 percent, Qatar Television said.
The decree is retroactive to July 1.
The six-nation Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) had agreed on the phased increase to 100 percent. The GCC groups Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain and Kuwait.
Saudi Arabia, the largest economy and market of the six states, has already raised duty on tobacco to 100 percent from 50 in line with the GCC accord to curb tobacco consumption.
Gulf Arab leaders in December agreed to raise the minimum tariff on tobacco products to 70 percent from 50 percent by July 1, but some members opted to implement a 100 percent increase.
